title: Planungsleistungen der Freianlage DGH Schwabenheim, Lph 5-9
description: Die Ortsgemeinde Schwabenheim beabsichtigt im Zusammenhang mit dem Neubau des Dorfgemeinschaftshauses "Greiffenklauer Hof" die weitere Planung und Umsetzung der zugehörigen Freianlagen. Gegenstand des Vergabeverfahrens sind die Planungsleistungen für Freianlagen gemäß Teil 3 Abschnitt 2 HOAI. Die Vergabe erfolgt im Rahmen eines EU-weiten Vergabeverfahrens. Für die Freianlagen liegt bereits eine Planung aus den vorangegangenen Leistungsphasen vor. Grundlage der weiteren Bearbeitung ist insbesondere die im März 2022 vom Rat beschlossene Planvariante. Diese sieht einen Veranstaltungshof im Bereich vor dem Bacchuskeller sowie die funktionale und gestalterische Einbindung der Freiflächen zwischen dem Dorfgemeinschaftshaus, den vorhandenen Gebäudeteilen und den angrenzenden öffentlichen Verkehrsflächen vor. Ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der Planung ist die Bewältigung der vorhandenen unterschiedlichen Geländehöhen und Erschließungssituationen. Nach der bisherigen Planung ist eine barrierefreie Erschließung von der Bachstraße und von der Schulstraße sowie eine barrierefreie Verbindung von der Bachstraße zum Hof vorgesehen. Eine barrierefreie Erschließung unmittelbar vom Veranstaltungshof war in der vom Rat beschlossenen Planvariante nicht vorgesehen. Bei der weiteren Planung sind insbesondere die vorhandene Bebauung und die bestehenden Kellerstrukturen, darunter der Bacchuskeller sowie weitere Kellerbereiche, die Anschlüsse an den Neubau und die umgebenden Straßenräume sowie die hieraus resultierenden Höhen- und Zugangssituationen zu berücksichtigen. Die vorliegenden Planunterlagen weisen unter anderem mehrere vorhandene Kellerbereiche aus, die bei der weiteren Planung zu berücksichtigen sind. Die Freianlagen sollen sowohl der Erschließung des Dorfgemeinschaftshauses als auch als Aufenthalts- und Veranstaltungsflächen dienen. Neben den befestigten Platz-, Wege- und Erschließungsflächen sind die erforderlichen Höhenübergänge, Einbauten, Vegetationsflächen und sonstigen Freiraumelemente planerisch weiterzuentwickeln und bis zur Ausführung zu begleiten. Leistungsumfang Gegenstand der Beauftragung sind die Leistungsphasen 5 bis 9 des Leistungsbildes Freianlagen gemäß § 39 HOAI HOAI i.V.m. Anlage 11 HOAI. Der Auftragnehmer hat die vorhandenen Planungsunterlagen zu übernehmen und auf dieser Grundlage die Planung ab Leistungsphase 5 fortzuführen. Die Leistungen umfassen damit insbesondere die ausführungsreife Durcharbeitung der bestehenden Planung, die Vorbereitung und Begleitung der Vergabe der ausführenden Leistungen, die Überwachung der fachgerechten Umsetzung der Freianlagen sowie die anschließende Objektbetreuung.

title: Short-Term Expert(s) – Telecommunications Cybersecurity and Resilience (Dominican Republic)
description: Short-Term Expert(s) – Telecommunications Cybersecurity and Resilience (Dominican Republic) This procurement concerns the engagement of one or two experts to support the National Cybersecurity Center of the Dominican Republic (CNCS) in assessing vulnerabilities and resilience within the country’s telecommunications environment and strengthening national capacity to conduct future assessments and manage related risks. The assignment combines a practical, risk-based assessment with embedded capacity building and knowledge transfer. The assignment will be implemented primarily as an on-site secondment in the Dominican Republic, with a maximum duration of 120 person-days over approximately six months, of which up to 30% may be delivered remotely. It may be delivered by one expert or two complementary experts and may additionally include up to 15 person-days of organisational backstopping support from the experts’ home organisation. The assignment is expected to commence in January 2027. HAUS Finnish Institute of Public Management Ltd implements this procurement on behalf of the Finnish Digital and Green Transition (FDGT) project. Through FDGT, HAUS mobilises Finnish expertise to support the digital development of public institutions in Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean through targeted expert secondments. These assignments provide a practical platform for applying Finnish know-how in international public-sector contexts while building professional networks and institutional partnerships with local stakeholders. Finnish experts may represent public sector organisations, private sector entities (from individual entrepreneurs to larger firms), or civil society organisations. The assignment supports the Dominican Republic’s efforts to strengthen cybersecurity and the resilience of critical telecommunications infrastructure. Working with CNCS and relevant national stakeholders, the expert(s) will conduct a practical vulnerability and resilience assessment, identify priority risks and capability gaps, and develop actionable recommendations while transferring practical expertise to Dominican counterparts. The secondment provides Finnish organisations with a relatively low-risk opportunity to gain first-hand experience, establish local networks and explore a new market. The expert(s) will work with CNCS as an established public-sector host and local counterpart, while the contract is concluded with HAUS and the main assignment-related costs, including expert remuneration, flights, accommodation and daily allowances, are covered under the agreed contractual arrangements. The Caribbean, and the Dominican Republic in particular, is receiving increasing attention in EU cooperation related to digital connectivity and infrastructure. The assignment can therefore provide a practical entry point for building relationships and market understanding that may support future institutional cooperation and business opportunities in the Dominican Republic and the wider region. HAUS handles the contracts and payments for the assignment. CNCS will act as the host organisation and principal technical counterpart, coordinating access to relevant institutions and stakeholders and supporting the assessment and validation of its findings. A more detailed description of the procurement is available in Annex 1 (ToR), which can be accessed by signing in to Tarjouspalvelu.,

description: Předmětem tohoto zadávacího řízení je uzavření Rámcové dohody s jedním dodavatelem pro každou část zadávacího řízení na dodávky plynů, kapalného dusíku a kapalného helia. Zadávací podmínky uvedené v těchto zadávacích podmínkách jsou shodné pro všechny části zadávacího řízení, s výjimkou těch míst, kde je výslovně uvedeno použití pro konkrétní část zadávacího řízení. Zadávací řízení je v souladu s § 35 ZZVZ rozděleno do následujících 3 částí: Část 1. – Plyny v láhvích – předmětem je poskytnutí tlakových lahví formou nájmu a dodávky plynů do místa plnění dle potřeb zadavatele. Část 2. – Kapalný dusík – předmětem je doplňování zásobníku kapalným dusíkem dle požadavků zadavatele. Zadavatel má vlastní Dewarovy nádoby, proto předmětem této části zakázky není pronájem nádob. Část 3. – Kapalné helium – předmětem je dodání zásobníku s kapalným heliem dle požadavků zadavatele. Pro pronájem nádob s kapalným heliem se počítá vždy cca 1 až 2 dny u zadavatele. Po dovozu nádob s heliem si zaměstnanci zadavatele objem nádob přelijí do vlastních nádob a nejpozději druhý den jsou zásobníky dodavatele k dispozici k odvozu. V případě dodání zásobníků zadavateli v ranních hodinách jsou zásobníky k dispozici k odvozu obvykle ten samý den ve večerních hodinách.

description: Gegenstand dieser Beschaffung ist der Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung für 3 Jahre für die Beschaffung von neuen Insektenkästen mit standardisierten Systemschachteln (Unit-Trays) unterschiedlicher Größe für das Umbetten von Sammlungsmaterial aus stark biozid-belasteten historischen Insektenkästen an den Standorten Bonn und Hamburg, den laufenden Maßnahmen der Sammlungsmobilisirung für das Neubauprojekt neues Naturkundemuseum Hamburg, und die Aufbewahrung und die langfriste Konservierung der Entomologischen Sammlungen des LIB an den Standorten Museum der Natur Hamburg und Museum Koenig in Bonn. Zudem müssen die Insektenkästen und Unit-Trays in Bezug auf Fertigung und Qualität die Anforderungen an DIN EN 16790:2016-12 (Integrierte Schädlingsbekämpfung, IPM) bestmöglich unterstützen und insbesondere Kasten und Deckel einen hermetisch dichten Abschluss und bestmöglichen Schutz gegenüber schädlichen Fraßinsekten bilden (z. title: Udbud af kontrakt vedrørende levering af tøj til asylansøgere m.fl.
description: Udlændingestyrelsen er ansvarlig for at tilvejebringe og drive indkvarteringssteder for asylansøgere m.fl., jf. udlændingelovens § 42 a, stk. 5. I praksis driver en række indkvarteringsoperatører disse steder på vegne af Udlændingestyrelsen. Når en udlænding indgiver en ansøgning om asyl i Danmark, dækker Udlændingestyrelsen udlændingens underhold, indtil denne meddeles opholdstilladelse, udrejser eller udsendes, jf. udlændingelovens § 42 a, stk. 1, 1. pkt., jf. dog stk. 3 og 4. Til dækning af udlændingens underhold hører blandt andet udlevering af tøjpakker og tøj i løse enkeltdele til kvinder, mænd og børn. Udlændingestyrelsen udbyder nu opgaven med at indkøbe, pakke og levere tøj til asylansøgere m.fl. med ikrafttræden pr. 1. februar 2027. Den udbudte kontrakt er ikke opdelt i delkontrakter, jf. udbudslovens § 49, stk. 2, da det er ordregivers vurdering, at der ved en manglende opdeling i delaftaler er mulighed for at opnå stordriftsfordele. Endvidere er det ordregivers vurdering, at der vil være administrative omkostninger forbundet med kontraktadministrationen ved opdeling i delaftaler.

title: Levering af hoved- og biretter til plejeboliger og Center for Rehabilitering og Forebyggelse i Gentofte Kommune
description: Udbuddet vedrører hoved- og biretter til borgere i Gentofte Kommunes plejehjem (plejeboliger), inkl. Daghjem samt hoved- og biretter til borgere på Center for Rehabilitering og Forebyggelse (CRF). Gentofte Kommune ønsker at tilbyde mad, der er indbydende, appetitvækkende og velsmagende samt af høj ernæringsmæssig og fødevare hygiejnisk kvalitet. Kommunen ønsker desuden, at borgerne får mad, der sikrer den nødvendige tilførsel af energi og næringsstoffer og lever op til de til en enhver tid gældende standarder og anbefalinger på området. Gentofte Kommune har fokus på at minimere fejlernæring blandt borgere i kommunens plejeboliger, brugere af Daghjem og indlagte på CRF, og leverandøren skal understøtte, at deres mad understøtter spisemiljøet, herunder anretning af maden. Det er leverandørens opgave at tilbyde et måltid, der kulinarisk og ernæringsmæssigt giver mulighed for at tilgodese den enkelte borgers behov og ønsker, så fejlernæring undgås. Gentofte Kommune ønsker ikke, at normalkost til raske ældre samt energi- og proteinrig kost levereres som frost. Dog kan enkelte komponenter godt leveres som frost, f.eks. grøntsager.

Arbeidsoppgavene instrumentet skal utføre omfatter: i) Overføring av DNA-templat, samt tilsetting av mastermikser og primere ii) Rensing av PCR-produkter (f.eks. magnetiske kuler) iii) Automatisert (“hands-off”) kvantifisering av DNA iv) Individuell normalisering av biblioteker basert på DNA-konsentrasjon v) Sammenslåing av biblioteker Planlagt gjennomstrømning er 20 000–30 000 prøver per år i en prøveflyt som normalt vil foregå i 4 x 96-brønnsplater med reaksjonsvolum på 5-20 uL. I fremtiden ser vi for oss at 384-brønnsplater vil bli en del av prøveflyten. Da instrumentet skal brukes post-PCR, er det viktig at instrumentdesignet tillater effektiv rengjøring og grundig dekontaminering. Vi søker et hurtig instrument med høy kapasitet, pipetteringspresisjon og -nøyaktighet – selv ved lave reaksjonsvolumer. Det er i tillegg et krav at roboten har stor fleksibilitet og et intuitivt brukergrensesnitt, slik at programmer kan opprettes og modifiseres av personell uten avansert programmeringskompetanse.

description: Dansk Politi udbyder kontrakt vedr. morskørsel. Delt op i fem (5) delaftaler: Delaftale 1: Morskørsel til Nordjyllands- og Midt- og Vestjyllands Politi Delaftale 2: Morskørsel til Østjyllands-, Sydøstjyllands- og Syd- og Sønderjyllands Politi Delaftale 3: Morskørsel til Fyns, Midt- og Vestsjællands og Sydsjælland og Lolland-Falsters Politi Delaftale 4: Morskørsel til Nordsjællands-, Københavns Vestegns- og Københavns Politi Delaftale 5: Morskørsel til Bornholms Politi Dansk politi har behov for kørsel af afdøde personer, der er erklæret for døde, og hvor dødsfaldet er omfattet af indberetningspligten jf. Sundhedslovens § 179, og hvor afdøde ikke ligger til offentligt skue. Kørslen omfatter to typer af kørsler, der skal udføres døgnet- og året rundt: 1. Almindelig morskørsel o Kørsel af afdøde fra opsamlingssted til et af politiets nærmere angivne steder. Dette kan eksempelvis være et kapel, et sygehus eller et retsmedicinsk institut, hvor der skal udføres et retslægeligt ligsyn. 2. Intern kørsel Udgangspunktet for Intern morskørsel er, at de kan planlægges mellem kunden og leverandøren. Intern kørsel bliver relevant i de situationer: o Hvor afdøde forud for dødens konstatering har været indbragt med ambulance til sygehus. Denne kørsel kan foregå mellem sygehus og kapel o Hvor der ved det retslægelige tilsyn vurderes, at der skal foretages obduktion. Denne kørsel består af to kørsler hhv. til retsmedicinsk institut og retur til udgangspunktet.

title: Udbud af tre rammeaftaler vedrørende indkøb af træningsudstyr
description: Team Danmarks organisation består af en administrerende direktør, en sportsdirektør og ca. 50 medarbejdere, som arbejder inden for syv sportsfaglige områder: Sportsligt samarbejde, karriere- og talentudvikling, sportsmedicin, sportsfysiologi, analyse, ernæring og psykologi. Team Danmarks vision er at skabe de bedst mulige vilkår og rammer for dansk eliteidræt og for de enkelte atleter. At udvikle eliteidræt i verdensklasse handler således for Team Danmark om at sikre en rød tråd gennem atletens rejse – fra klubben, hvor det hele starter, hele vejen til toppen af medaljeskamlen og videre til livet efter sportskarrieren. Det handler både om mennesker og medaljer. For at kunne udleve denne vision er det afgørende, at Team Danmarks atleter og trænere har adgang til træningsudstyr af høj kvalitet, der understøtter optimal træning, restitution og præstation på højeste internationale niveau. Team Danmark ønsker således med dette udbud at indkøbe træningsudstyr, som netop skal bidrage til at sikre de danske eliteatleter de bedst mulige fysiske rammer og vilkår for at udvikle og udleve deres fulde potentiale inden for et samlet budget på 8 mio. kr. ekskl. moms. På denne baggrund udbyder Team Danmark følgende tre ikke eksklusive delkontrakter, der alle udbydes som rammeaftaler for en 4-årig periode, men hvor den leverandør, der tildeles den enkelte delkontrakt, er garanteret et engangsindkøb, der foretages af Team Danmark umiddelbart efter indgåelsen af den relevante delkontrakt, og hvor det træningsudstyr, der omfattes af engangsindkøbet, skal leveres til Team Danmark senest i løbet af april 2027: (i) Delkontrakt A, der vedrører et engangsindkøb af cardioudstyr samt løbende indkøb af cardioudstyr med et maksimumbeløb på i alt 2,5 mio. kr. ekskl. moms (ii) Delkontrakt B, der vedrører et engangsindkøb af træningsmaskiner samt løbende indkøb af træningsmaskiner med et maksimumbeløb på i alt 2,5 mio. kr. ekskl. moms (iii) Delkontrakt C, der vedrører et engangsindkøb af stænger og frivægte samt løbende indkøb af stænger og frivægter med et maksimumbeløb på i alt 3 mio. kr. ekskl. moms. Det engangsindkøb, som Team Danmark forpligter sig til at foretage umiddelbart efter indgåelsen af den relevante delkontrakt, er nærmere defineret i tilbudslisten. Udover engangsindkøbet har Team Danmark ikke aftagepligt på hverken delkontrakt A, delkontrakt B eller delkontrakt C. Det forventet indkøbsbehov over de næste fire år er indsat i tilbudslisten til brug for evalueringen. Dette forventede indkøbsbehov er alene vejledende og baseret på Team Danmarks skøn over det forventede indkøb og er således ikke bindende for Team Danmark. Dette betyder, at de(n) leverandør, der tildeles delkontrakt A og/eller delkontrakt B eller delkontrakt C, ikke kan gøre krav gældende mod Team Danmark, hvis Team Danmarks indkøbsbehov viser sig at være mindre end det, der er anført i tilbudslisten. Ligeledes skal leverandøren på hver delaftale kunne levere større mængder, end hvad der fremgår af det estimerede indkøb, idet der i alle tre delkontrakter er en bestemmelse om, at Team Danmark er berettiget til at forhøje delkontrakternes ramme med 50 % indtil seks måneder før delkontrakternes indkøbsperiodes udløb Opdelingen i tre delkontrakter er begrundet i, at markedet for henholdsvis cardio-udstyr (delkontrakt A), træningsmaskiner (delkontrakt B) samt stænger og frivægte (delkontrakt C) i vidt omfang består af forskellige og til dels specialiserede leverandører, hvorfor en opdeling giver flere virksomheder, herunder mindre og mere specialiserede leverandører, mulighed for at afgive tilbud på den eller de delkontrakter, der matcher deres forretningsområde. Opdelingen understøtter dermed konkurrencen om den enkelte delkontrakt og øger sandsynligheden for, at Team Danmark modtager konkurrencedygtige tilbud på samtlige tre produktkategorier. Tilbudsgiver kan afgive tilbud på alle delkontrakter. En tilbudsgiver kan tildeles delkontrakt A og delkontrakt B, men kan ikke samtidig tildeles delkontrakt C. Den tilbudsgiver, der tildeles delkontrakt C, kan således alene tildeles denne delkontrakt. Dette betyder, at tilbudsgiver, hvis tilbudsgiver tildeles delkontrakt C, ikke kan tildeles delkontrakt A og/eller delkontrakt B. Tildeles tilbudsgiver delkontrakt A, kan tilbudsgiver godt blive tildelt delkontrakt B. Tilsvarende kan tilbudsgiver godt blive tildelt delkontrakt B, hvis tilbudsgiver tildeles delkontrakt A. Delkontrakterne forventes at træde i kraft ved kontraktunderskrivelse og løber herefter i 48 måneder. De krav, der stilles til det træningsudstyr, der er omfattet af henholdsvis delkontrakt A, delkontrakt B og delkontrakt C, er nærmere beskrevet i kravsspecifikationen, der er vedlagt som en del af udbudsmaterialet. Tilbudsgiver skal stille en række vareprøver til rådighed for Team Danmark. De vareprøver, som tilbudsgiver skal stille til rådighed for Team Danmark, er markeret med grøn i tilbudslisten, der indgår som en del af det samlede udbudsmateriale. Udbuddet gennemføres elektronisk ved brug af udbudsportalen www.udbuddet.dk. Tilbudsgiver skal derfor oprettes som licenshaver hos www.udbuddet.dk. Oprettelse kan ske uden omkostning. Hvis der nogetsteds i kravsspecifikationen eller udbudsmaterialet i øvrigt er henvist til standarder, skal enhver henvisning forstås som en henvisning til den nævnte standard eller tilsvarende. Opfylder tilbudsgiver ikke den nævnte standard, men tilsvarende, skal tilbudsgiver i tilbuddet dokumentere, at den tilbudte løsning på de relevante parametre er tilsvarende. Ireland – Architectural design services – Tipperary County Council Procurement of Single-Party Framework Agreement for Architect-Led Integrated Design Team Consultancy Services for Clonmel, Co. Tipperary
description: Tipperary County Council Procurement of Single-Party Framework Agreement for Architect-Led Integrated Design Team Consultancy Services for Clonmel, Co. Tipperary. Tipperary County Council is undertaking a competitive tendering process for the establishment of a Single-Party Framework Agreement for Architect-Led Integrated Multi-Disciplinary Consultancy Services for Public Realm, Landscape and Building Upgrade Projects in Clonmel, Co. Tipperary. The Framework Agreement will require the successful Consultant to provide, either directly or through its proposed multi-disciplinary team, all of the following services: 1. Architectural Services – Public Realm 2. Conservation Architectural Services 3. Landscape Architectural Services 4. Civil and Structural Engineering Services 5. Quantity Surveying Services 6. Project Management Services 7. Project Supervisor Design Process (PSDP) Services 8. Employer’s Representative Services 9. Public Liaison / Stakeholder Engagement Services 10. Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Services 11. Planning Services 12. Archaeological Services 13. Fire Engineering Services Only Applicants capable of providing all of the above disciplines and associated specialist expertise, whether in-house, through subcontractors or as part of a grouping/consortium, will be considered. This competition will be conducted using a restricted procedure. At Stage 1, Applicants will be assessed against the suitability and selection criteria set out in the Suitability Assessment Questionnaire. It is intended that the five highest-scoring Applicants, subject to a sufficient number meeting all minimum requirements and rules for selection, will be invited to participate in Stage 2. At Stage 2, shortlisted Applicants will be issued with the Invitation to Tender and associated tender documentation. Tenders will be evaluated in accordance with the award criteria and weightings set out in the Invitation to Tender. The highest-ranked compliant Tenderer will be appointed to the Single-Party Framework Agreement and will also be awarded the Initial Contract. The Initial Contract will relate to the further development and delivery of public realm and associated projects in Clonmel. Clonmel Town Centre requires a significant streetscape and public realm upgrade. A design previously received Part VIII approval; however, the design now requires further development, amendment and coordination to reflect the current project scope and available funding and to bring the project through detailed design, tender, construction and handover stages. Tipperary County Council has also acquired a protected structure for which design development and a Part VIII planning process will be required. The Architect-Led Design Team may therefore be required to deliver a combination of public realm, landscape, civil engineering and building upgrade works, including works to protected and heritage structures. The Architect will act as Lead Consultant and will be responsible for coordinating and managing the full multi-disciplinary design team, programme, cost and delivery of the projects. During the construction stage, the Design Team will be required to provide ongoing technical support, respond to queries arising on site and advise on proposed variations and other matters affecting the delivery of the works. Projects arising under the Framework Agreement are anticipated to be funded, in whole or in part, through the Towns and Cities Regeneration Investment Fund (TCRIF) and/or other available funding programmes. Please note that an ITT is not required for this stage of the tender process.

title: Sanierung und Erweiterung Kindertagesstätte St.Michael, Bietigheim - Rohbau-, Erdbau-, Entwässerungs- und Abbrucharbeiten
description: Die Gemeinde Bietigheim plant die energetische Sanierung und den Umbau der bestehenden Kita St. Michael. Durch den Umbau sollen die räumlichen Voraussetzungen für die Betreuung von insgesamt 10 Krippen und Kindergartengruppen geschaffen werden. Maximal werden 190 Kinder in der Einrichtung betreut. Hierbei sind aktuelle pädagogische Anforderungen sowie die Belange des Brandschutzes und der Barrierefreiheit zu berücksichtigen. Ebenso soll die Haustechnik komplett erneuert und an die Anforderungen an Nachhaltigkeit und Komfort angepasst werden. Das Bestandsgebäude wurde ca. 1975 errichtet und umfasst ein Kellergeschoss und Erdgeschoss. Über die Jahre wurden an diesem Bestandsbau diverse Änderungen vorgenommen und mehrere Erweiterungen angebaut, zuletzt 2017. Es werden einzelne Gebäudeteile und der Innenausbau inkl. Technik rückgebaut. Hierfür sind Sicherungsmaßnahmen notwendig. Das bestehende Tragwerk des ursprünglichen Gebäudes hat sich als nicht ausreichend tragfähig herausgestellt. Im Untergeschoss müssen Fundamente unterfangen werden und neue Fundamente für neue Wände erstellt werden. Nach den Rückbauarbeiten werden neue Mauerwerks- und Stahlbetonwände und Stahlbetondecken hergestellt. Die Grundleitungen werden rückgebaut und neu verlegt. Seitlich am Gebäude werden Abgrabungen hergestellt, mit mehreren Stützwänden. Die Kindertagesstätte hat nach ihrer Sanierung eine BGF von ca. 2500 m² und einen BRI von ca. 8700 m³. Es werden Rohbau-, Erdbau- und Entwässerungs- und Abbrucharbeiten in folgendem Umfang ausgeschrieben: Abbrucharbeiten: ca. 1700 m² Bodenaufbau, inkl. Estrich Rückbau Wandbeläge, Abhangdecken ca. 1000 m² Mauerwerkswände ca. 1500 m² Stahlbetondecken (Rippen und Flachdecken) ca. 220 m² Fenster Rückbau Containeranbau mit ca. 150 m² sämtliche HLS und Elektroinstallationen im Bestand (auch Grundleitungen) Erdbauarbeiten: ca. 2300 m³ Bodenaushub komplette Entwässerungsarbeiten Erdungsanlage Rohbauarbeiten: ca. 65 lfm Fundamentunterfangungen Streifenfundamente für Abstützungen, neue Streifenfundamente ca. 500 m² Bodenplatte STB im UG ca. 270 m² Bodenplatte STB im EG ca. 1500 m² Decken aus Stahlbeton ca. 1200 m² Wände aus Stahlbeton ca. 400 m² Wände aus Mauerwerk ca. 1500 m² STB Decken über UG, EG und OG Abdichtung auf der Bodenplatte

title: Peltisepäntöiden puitejärjestely
description: Peltisepäntöiden puitejärjestely Museovirasto, Suomenlinnan hoitokunta -osasto ("Hankintayksikkö") kilpailuttaa Suomenlinnan ja Seurasaaren kiinteistöjen peltisepäntyöt ("Palvelu"). Tavoitteena on perustaa puitesopimus, jonka kautta Hankintayksiköllä on mahdollista hankkia Palveluita tarpeidensa mukaisesti. Palvelua teetetään Hankintayksikön hallinnoimissa rakennuksissa, joissa sijaitsee toimitiloja, työtiloja, asuntoja sekä museorakennuksia. Palvelussa kiinnitetään erityistä huomiota kohteen kulttuurihistoriallisiin arvoihin, ominaispiirteisiin, materiaaleihin ja vanhoihin rakennustapoihin. Töitä tehdään eri aikakausina rakennetuissa kohteissa, ja niitä tehdään ympärivuotisesti. Palveluihin kuuluvat esimerkiksi: • vesikatteiden peltityöt kuten katepeltien asennukset ja saumaukset • syöksytorvet ja räystäskourut • ikkunapellitykset sekä hormien ja läpivientien peltiasennukset • peltikatteiden tiivistyskorjaukset ja kattoturvatuotteiden asennukset. Tarjoaja voi toimia toimeksiannoissa joko päätoteuttajana tai sivu-urakoitsijana. Työkohteet ovat vaihtelevia ja osa kohteista on hyvin pieniä. Puitejärjestelyn perusteella tehtävät työt ovat pääsääntöisesti tuntihintaperusteisena laskutustyönä tehtäviä erilaisia peltisepäntöitä. Töitä voidaan teettää myös erilaisilla urakkamuodoilla. Työnaikainen dokumentointi ja valokuvaus sisältyvät kaikkiin töihin. Valituilla toimittajilla on mahdollisuus käyttää Hankintayksikön järjestämiä, yhteyskäytössä olevia henkilöstötiloja Suomenlinnassa puitesopimuksen mukaisten toimeksiantojen aikana. Tiloista peritään vuokraa, joka sovitaan erikseen. Seurasaaressa ei ole yhteiskäyttöisiä henkilöstötiloja. Hankinnan kohde on esitelty tarkemmin jäljempänä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. PUITEJÄRJESTELY Hankinnan tuloksena perustetaan puitejärjestely. Kokonaistaloudellisen edullisuuden valintaperuste on paras hinta-laatusuhde, minkä perusteella Hankintayksikkö valitsee neljä (4) parhaat pisteet saanutta palveluntuottajaa, ellei kelpoisuusehdot täyttäviä tarjoajia tai hyväksyttäviä tarjouksia ole vähemmän. Mikäli hyväksyttäviä tarjouksia vastaanotetaan vähemmän kuin edellä on esitetty, valitsee Hankintayksikkö kaikki tarjoajat automaattisesti mukaan puitejärjestelyyn, mikäli kaikki Hankintayksikön tarjoajalle ja sen tarjoamille palveluille asetetut vaatimukset täyttyvät. Sopimuskausi alkaa puitesopimuksen (hankintasopimuksen) allekirjoittamisesta ja jatkuu kolme (3) vuotta). Lisäksi Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden jatkaa sopimuskautta yhden (1) vuoden optiokaudella. Yksittäiset tilaukset puitejärjestelyn sisällä tehdään kevennetyn kilpailutuksen perusteella. Puitejärjestelystä tehdyn sopimuksen ehtoja ja sisältöä noudatetaan kaikissa Hankintayksikön ja puitejärjestelyyn valitun tarjoajan välisissä suhteissa. Puitejärjestelyyn perustuva toimeksianto voidaan tehdä vain puitesopimuksen voimassaoloaikana. Tarjoajan on otettava huomioon, että puitejärjestelyyn perustuvia toimeksiantoja toteutetaan Hankintayksikön päättämän aikataulun mukaisesti, jolloin toimeksiannot eivät välttämättä jakaudu tasaisesti sopimuskauden ajalle. Hankintayksikkö hankkii Palveluita omien tarpeidensa mukaisesti, eikä Hankintayksikkö sitoudu vähimmäisostomääriin. Puitesopimus ei anna valituille toimittajille yksinoikeutta hankittavien palveluiden toimittamiseen.,

GOVERNMENT REQUIREMENTS: The purpose of this project is to construct a full width ramp with a series of 31 weirs and pools. These weirs are designed as an upstream-pointing arch with side slopes which concentrate the flow towards the center of the channel. Further design elements include a 4-foot-wide V-notch in the weir and 1.5-foot diameter boulders emplaced on the weir. The 31st weir (upstream most weir) will be constructed entirely of concrete the intent is to protect the less robust rock emplacements by breaking up incoming ice. Construction of the fishway will involve partial demolition and excavation of the spillway and underlying bedrock to anchor the fishway to the rock and replace the existing spillway. On the downstream end of the fishway the existing channel will be removed for a length of 150 feet. A four foot-wide embedded low-flow channel in the center of the fishway has been designed to provide sufficient depth of water and flow during normal low flow conditions to allow fish passage. A series of parallel transverse rock ridges that consist of 1�6� foot diameter stones will be evenly spaced along the length of the ramp to provide a series of pools and falls. title: APN - CETEMT New Facility and Compound, CFB Uplands
description: Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform the Design-Builder of an upcoming contract opportunity at CFB Uplands in Ottawa, Ontario. The purpose of this APN is to allow the Design-Builder to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested Design-Builders to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that this project will include an Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process.   Description of the Project and Services   This contract will provide the design and construction of the new facility and compound near the existing CETEMT (Counter Explosive Threat Equipment Management Team) compound at CFB Uplands. The new facility will be a single-storey building with an approximate footprint of 1,650 m2. It will include offices and workspaces, meeting rooms, maintenance garages and workshops, specialized spaces such as secure storage and a weapons vault, and support areas including a kitchenette, washrooms, and server rooms. The facility will be situated within a new exterior compound of approximately 6,500 m2, including parking areas.   The delivery method for this infrastructure will be a Modified Design-Build (MDB) contract. ROM estimate for the total value of the MDB contract is approximately $17M. It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND.   Contract Number: 88076 Title: CETEMT New Facility and Compound Approximate Estimate: $ 17M Anticipated Posting: Q4 FY26/27 Description: Provide the Counter Explosive Threat Equipment Management Team (CETEMT) a new facility and compound on CFB Uplands in Ottawa, Ontario according to operational requirements.   Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a Design-Builder will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated industrial security requirements of this project will be at FSC Secret. Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing Design-Builders  early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, Design-Builders that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential Design-Builders with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants or contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice); Contract number 88076; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants or contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a consultant or contractor: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (Contract number listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX, has  met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and has submitted a proposal or a bid DCC will  send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent or bidder regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent or bidder will need to promptly cooperate with CSP  to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca   Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Priscille Vumi Leader, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada 343-596-6289 Priscille.Vumi@dcc-cdc.gc.caBidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

title: MINERVA Initiative – Uncrewed Aircraft System Deconfliction
description: *Please note that the ISC website will be available on September 23, 2026* This Challenge Notice is issued under the Innovative Solutions Canada Program (ISC) Call for Proposals 004 (EN578-24ISC4). For general ISC information, Offerors can visit the ISC website at: https://ised-isde.canada.ca/site/innovative-solutions-canada/en Please refer to the Solicitation Documents Innovative Solutions Canada Program Call for Proposals – 004 - Tender Notice | CanadaBuys https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities/tender-notice/cb-331-17030872 which contains the process for submitting a proposal. Steps to apply: Step 1: Read this challenge. Step 2: Read the Call for Proposals : https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities/tender-notice/cb-331-17030872 Step 3: Propose your solution here : https://ised-isde.canada.ca/site/innovative-solutions-canada/en/minerva-initiative-uncrewed-aircraft-system-deconfliction Challenge title: MINERVA Initiative – Uncrewed Aircraft System Deconfliction Challenge sponsor: Department of National Defense (DND) Funding Mechanism: Contract MAXIMUM CONTRACT VALUE: $500,000.00 CAD Multiple contracts could result from this Challenge. Phase 2: - The maximum funding available for any Phase 2 contract resulting from this Challenge is : $500,000.00 CAD excluding applicable taxes, shipping, travel and living expenses, as required. - The maximum duration for any Phase 2 contract resulting from this Challenge is up to 15 months (excluding submission of the final report). - Estimated number of Phase 2 contracts: 5 This disclosure is made in good faith and does not commit Canada to award any contract for the total approximate funding. Final decisions on the number of Phase 2 awards will be made by Canada on the basis of factors such as evaluation results, departmental priorities and availability of funds. Canada reserves the right to make partial awards and to negotiate project scope changes. Note: Selected companies are eligible to receive one contract per phase per challenge. Travel: Travel to Suffield, Alberta for prototype demonstration. Kick-off Meeting: All communication will take place by telephone or videoconference. Progress Review Meeting(s): Any progress review meetings will be conducted by telephone or videoconference. Final Review Meeting: All communication will take place by telephone or videoconference. Problem Statement: Challenge Statement Summary The challenge is to provide the Department of National Defense (DND) and the Canadian Army (CA) a software solution to provide an airspace common operating picture so that it can plan, deconflict, and control uncrewed aircraft system (UAS) traffic, including their use of the radio frequency (RF) spectrum, in order to ensure the safe and efficient management of UAS to enable the Canadian soldier to successfully fight and survive on the future battlefield. Details: Essential Outcomes The proposed solution must: 1. Be Windows-based. 2. Allow a user to create and store flight plans, including radio frequency requirements. 3. Have a flight plan repository (database) that stores the 4D (3D + time) trajectories and spectrum requirements of all accepted flight plans. 4. Enable integration of supplemental data services such as crewed aircraft flight plans and weather. 5. Generate an optimal 4D flight path for UAS based on specific mission goals and physical limits. 6. Be able to check new flight requests against existing flight plans, airspace constraints (no-fly zones) and RF spectrum requests to detect conflicts and resolve them (via set priorities or a human decision). 7. Generate 4D blocks of deconflicted airspace (a "tunnel" or a "box") where a UAS is permitted to fly. Additional Outcomes The proposed solution should: 1. Analyze real-time data from UASs to prevent collisions and automatically adjust flight paths for UASs in controlled airspace. 2. Check in real-time whether a UAS is following its pre-approved, deconflicted trajectory. 3. Demonstrate capacity in having its critical components produced and sourced in countries within the NATO alliance, NATO Partners or Major Non-NATO Allies. To achieve this, Offerors are requested to provide as an attachment to their proposal, a list identifying the solution's critical components, the country of production and sourcing for each component. Critical components and requested information for each Critical components are defined below: Critical components: 1. Radio 2. Ground control station (GCS) 3. On-board computer 4. Any software Requested information: i. Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM): Name of the original equipment manufacturer of the product being sourced ii. OEM URL: Provide the URL of the OEM iii. Software: Confirm if developed by Offeror or outsourced iv. Product name: Provide the OEM's product name v. Model number: Provide the OEM's model and/or version number of the product vi. Product URL: Provide the URL of the OEM product, model, and version vii. Country of origin IMPORTANT NOTE: For this challenge, kindly disregard the Attachment requirements detailed at Section D in the Web-Portal, and instead adhere to the following: - The attachment measures 8.5" by 11" with a maximum size of 10Mb. - Only the following formats will be accepted: JPG, GIF, TIF, PDF or PNG. - The attachment must be clear and legible. Note: Including an attachment is not mandatory, but forms part of the Additional Outcomes, which is scored up to 10 points. The Applicant (Offeror) acknowledges that it is within Canada's sole discretion to determine whether the attachment is removed or included in the Offer. Background & Context The CA is undergoing a generational modernization effort to address the evolving nature of technology, the changing character of conflict, and the unravelling of the geopolitical system. The transformative changes being made are conceptually described in the CA publication Inflection Point 2025. This document provides the broad context for modernization and directs the development and acquisition of key systems; in particular, it states: Key to this transformation is the integration of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, robotics, autonomous and uncrewed systems. These capabilities will support a wide range of functions, from intelligence analysis and predictive modeling to targeting and operational execution. The CA, in recognizing this need, has purchased foreign robotics and autonomous systems of varying quality and has identified challenges purchasing systems that meet operational requirements, in particular related to cold-weather operations, and that have stable supply chains. Further, purchases have, in the past, been constrained by limited manufacturing capacity of industry partners. To address this, the Government of Canada's recently released policy Canada's Defence Industrial Strategy, emphasizes the need to develop a strong domestic industrial capacity to produce defence materiel. This policy directs the CA to seek solutions to operational problems through Canadian industry, which will both improve the CA's capability while providing the foundation of a strong defence industrial base able to scale production of quality defence material. To date, engagements with Canadian industry have revealed a wide variety of small/medium companies that have commercial technologies that could, with support, be tailored to military requirements.

description: Advance Procurement Notice REPLACEMENT OF AIRFIELD LIGHTING POWER CENTRE (ALPC) 4 WING COLD LAKE, ALBERTA (with Security Requirements) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at 4 Wing Cold Lake, Alberta. The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Description of the Project and Services 4 Wing Cold Lake, Alberta requires replacement of the existing Airfield Lighting Power Centre (ALPC) building with a new ALPC building. The project will improve the reliability and efficiency of electrical power supplied to the Airfield Lighting System and support continuous flying operations.  The new system will supply power to new LED airfield lighting systems planned for installation over a five-year period starting in 2027. The existing ALPC will continue to power the existing incandescent lighting system until those systems have been replaced with LED systems.  The Department of National Defence intends to retain a contractor for work including, but not necessarily limited to, the following:  Civil and site preparation work, including concrete pads, slabs and footings for the building and fuel tank; extension of airfield lighting circuits to the new location; and design and construction of the new ALPC facility, including equipment, controls and lighting-control software.  Removal of the existing approximately 63.7 m² ALPC building, including its foundation, fuel tank and power systems, after the new building and power systems have been installed and commissioned.  Supply and installation of a new, approximately 100 m², prefabricated steel ALPC building configured in two sections: an airfield regulator section and a generator section.  Precast concrete manholes, airfield series lighting cable, and concrete-encased direct-buried electrical services.  Associated airfield electrical work performed by journeyperson airfield electricians in accordance with CSA Z463-18.  It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. title: Pyrophoric Device Demonstration
description: The Department of War (DoW) Joint Services (US Navy, US Marine Corps, Army, Air Force, Special Operations Command (SOCOM) and Air Force Special Operations Command (AFSOC)) require an expendable pyrophoric countermeasure to use independently or in conjunction with both onboard and offboard countermeasures. The DoW has a need to develop a new source for this crucial countermeasure capability. One of the primary missions of the Platform Protection & Countermeasures Technologies Division (WXR) is to develop countermeasures to protect U.S. aircraft from threat missile systems. Expendable Countermeasures have been utilized to protect U.S. aircraft against surface-to-air and air-to-air threats since as early as the 1960s. Once the presence of a missile is indicated, a pilot releases an expendable countermeasure in an attempt to decoy the missile. The countermeasure and countermeasure techniques are designed to confuse the missile seeker and its counter-countermeasure logic, ultimately causing it to decoy away from aircraft. Expendable countermeasures are part of a multi-layer approach to protect aircraft from enemy threat missiles. In their simplest form, the concept of expendable countermeasures is to provide a decoy that is �more attractive� than the aircraft being protected, thereby pulling the threat missile�s targeting system away from the aircraft and towards the decoy. In total, any mechanism by which the expendable interferes with the missile�s targeting system sufficiently to make it miss the aircraft is a success. This effort is in response to finding a new supplier of pyrophoric countermeasures. Pyrophoric countermeasures (M211, MJU-49/B, MJU-64/B, MJU-66/B, XM219, MJU-50A/B, MJU-51A/B, & MJU-52A/B) remain an active part of IR threat protection systems offering the best solution for the Joint Services to counter legacy and advanced IR missile threats.
